name: Tame Me
source:
You come to your senses in someone else's bed, your whole body aches, but the wounds are well treated. After everything you've been through, you hope that your savior will be a kind person. However, the stranger turns out to be much less friendly than you expected. He claims that it is dangerous to be around him, but you know that there is nothing worse than going back to where you escaped from.

[From [url=https://dillayaart.itch.io/tame-me]itch.io[/url]]
